description: Creates a download link (valid 15 minutes, no sign-in needed to open it) for a finished conversion in one of these formats: xlsx, csv, xero, qbo, qbcsv, tally, report. xlsx is an Excel workbook with transactions, summary and categories; csv is Date, Description, Money Out, Money In, Amount, Balance, Category; xero and qbcsv are import files for Xero and QuickBooks; qbo is QuickBooks Web Connect; tally is Tally XML (bank_ledger and offset_ledger name the ledgers); report is the reconciliation report as PDF. When the file held several accounts, account picks one (0-based); without it xlsx carries every account and the other formats carry account 0.

account.description: 0-based account index when the file held several accounts (see get_conversion.accounts). Without it, xlsx gets every account as its own sheet and the other formats get account 0.

bank_ledger.description: tally only: the bank ledger name in Tally.

conversion_id.description: The conversion id returned by convert_statement or list_conversions.

format.description: xlsx (Excel), csv (generic), xero (Xero bank statement CSV), qbo (QuickBooks Web Connect), qbcsv (QuickBooks 3-column CSV), tally (Tally XML), report (reconciliation PDF).

offset_ledger.description: tally only: the offset (clearing) ledger name in Tally.

name: get_download_link
title: Get a download link
